change: Rewrote the arch-v2 SCReLU head dot product from per-lane i64 arithmetic to chunked i32 arithmetic (screlu_dot in PieBot/src/eval/nnue/network.rs). Each term is bounded by QA^2*127 = 8,258,175 at QA=255, so partial sums widen to i64 every 128 terms and cannot overflow; the result is integer-identical to the i64 reference for every valid model.
why: The i64 formulation blocked auto-vectorization entirely: 2048 dependent 64-bit multiply chains per evaluation. i32 lanes let both NEON and AVX2 vectorize the clamp/square/multiply/accumulate sequence.
correctness: All four arch-v2 parity tests still pass unchanged, including python_exported_gold_model_evaluates_identically (a Python-quantized PIENNQ02 model asserted integer-exact from Rust against an independent Python integer reference) and incremental_updates_match_full_recompute_over_random_games.

measurement.method: Interactive UCI, Threads 1, Hash 256, blend 100, go movetime 3000, 4 positions x 2 rounds, NPS = nodes/wall. Same model file in both arms, so the search trees are identical and NPS is directly comparable.
measurement.hardware: Apple M-series (NEON, -C target-cpu=native). Re-measure on the AVX2 box before relying on the exact ratio there.

model_random_weights_h1024.caveat: A random-weight net produces a degenerate (nearly constant) eval and therefore an unusually easy tree, so its absolute NPS and any cross-model ratio are NOT representative. Only the before/after ratio on the identical model is meaningful. The earlier 0.231x figure in arch_v2_h1024_speed_probe_20260808.json was measured on this random net and overstated the slowdown; the trained-net figure (0.247x before, 0.489x after) supersedes it.

outcome: Arch-v2 h1024 now searches at 0.489x the NPS of v1 h64 on a trained net, roughly half a ply behind at equal time, down from a full 2-ply deficit. The remaining gate handicap is on the order of 30-60 Elo rather than 100-150.
next: Explicit NEON/AVX2 intrinsics for the accumulator delta (i16 add/sub over 1024 lanes) and a fused clamp-square-madd head could add more; measure on the AVX2 box before investing, since the auto-vectorized i32 form may already be close to optimal there.
